SongComments.SongComment: This tutorial song shows some meta device and pattern command tricks, creates various different sounds from a simple sine wave using native Renoise FX only.
Navigate through the tracks and take a look at the Track DSPs & Patterns, to see how the sounds and devices are assembled, used here.

"Meta Devices" are a very powerful and unique feature of Renoise. Such devices can be added just like "normal" Track DSPs: *Meta Devices in the Track DSPs list. But instead of manipulating a tracks audio stream, they do manipulate / modulate other FX parameters.

This allows you for example to constantly modulate (*LFO Device) parameter changes, or sync (*Key-Tracking *Velocity Device) parameter changes to notes/velocities. With a *Signal Follower you can even transform audio signals to automation to create sidechaining alike effects and much more.
You can also combine Meta Devices with others with the *Hydra or *XY-Pad Devices to create even more complex routings.
Thanks to Kasmo for providing this excellent example.
